description:
Result Detail and Compare are where users decide whether a result is credible
and whether one platform is meaningfully faster. The audit found that Result
Detail overweights the Run Receipt in the first viewport while primary
metrics are inline text, and Compare has chart overflow/blank-space issues in
the speedup chart. Both pages also inherit the broader badge, table, chart
control, and light-surface inconsistencies.

This item should redesign the information hierarchy for single-result and
multi-result analysis. It must preserve reproducibility and methodology
detail, but make the first read sharper: what was run, what metric matters,
what can be trusted, what differs between runs, and where to inspect query
details.

anti_patterns.dont: claim a winner when severe benchmark/scale mismatches suppress winner claims.
demote reproducibility so far that the result no longer feels auditable.
introduce a user-selectable primary metric toggle unless the benchmark-derived contract is intentionally reopened.
use chart labels that overflow the SVG viewport or require horizontal page scroll.

preserves.behavior: Comparability receipt logic and mismatch suppression behavior.
Compare route `?ids=` share URL contract and compact ID canonicalization.
Run Receipt reproducibility details and download links.

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm test -- src/pages/__tests__/ResultDetail.test.tsx src/pages/__tests__/Compare.test.tsx src/components/__tests__/CompareSummary.test.tsx src/components/__tests__/ComparabilityReceipt.test.tsx src/components/__tests__/QueryDiffTable.test.tsx
verifications.description: Result Detail and Compare tests pass

verifications.command: echo 'Manual: capture result detail and compare at 390, 768, 1280, 1600; inspect first viewport, charts, tables, disclosures, and overflow'
verifications.description: Manual compare/detail responsive captures are clean

work_units.notes:
Outcome: hierarchy is now encoded in the pages. Result Detail leads with a
compact result-summary panel (workload, platform, trust/visibility badges,
scale, date, primary metric, geomean, wall-clock, driver), followed by the
Run Receipt and then environment/actions/charts/tables. Compare leads with
a compact comparison summary, then comparability receipt, decision summary,
baseline control, query-level diff, result cards, and charts.
work_units.summary: Map the decision hierarchy for Result Detail and Compare

work_units.notes:
Outcome: inline metric text was replaced with tokenized metric cards in a
`panel-elevated` summary. The Run Receipt remains prominent immediately
below the summary so reproducibility stays in the first analytical read
without consuming the whole first viewport.
work_units.summary: Redesign Result Detail top summary and receipt placement

work_units.notes:
Outcome: Environment, Tuning Config, Actions, Query Timings, Individual
samples, MethodologyDisclosure, and RunReceipt now use the shared surface,
text, border, status, and scroll-affordance tokens. ChartPanel already
consumed the shared chart-control shell from the foundation pass; chart SVGs
now opt into `.bb-chart-svg` to prevent container overflow.
work_units.summary: Retheme Result Detail environment, actions, charts, timing tables, and methodology sections

work_units.notes:
Outcome: Compare now leads with a tokenized comparison-summary panel, and
ComparabilityReceipt uses differentiated StatusBadge roles/tones for match,
differs, missing, warnings, and no-difference states. The baseline selector
uses the shared `<Select>` primitive and sits directly above the query-level
evidence it controls.
work_units.summary: Redesign Compare top summary, comparability receipt, and baseline control

work_units.notes:
Outcome: chart SVGs used by Result Detail and Compare adopt `.bb-chart-svg`
so their outer SVG cannot exceed the containing scroll surface at narrow
widths. Existing benchmark-derived chart eligibility/default behavior is
preserved; this pass does not reopen the primary-metric contract.
work_units.summary: Fix Compare chart layout, overflow, labels, and default chart choice

work_units.notes:
Outcome: QueryDiffTable, CompareSummary, ComparabilityReceipt, and Compare
result cards use tokenized surfaces and StatusBadge tones. Faster/slower/
tie/missing states remain semantically distinct without relying on legacy
badge color class names.
work_units.summary: Retheme Query-Level Diff and result cards

work_units.notes:
Outcome: existing ResultDetail, Compare, chart smoke, CompareSummary,
ComparabilityReceipt, and QueryDiffTable tests remain the regression
contract. The release-gate capture matrix now includes representative
Result Detail, same-cohort Compare, and mismatch Compare routes so visual
QA no longer skips these public surfaces.
work_units.summary: Add focused regression coverage for charts and hierarchy
